blind.description: A square medieval masonry tower or wall turret constructed from rough-hewn stone blocks in muted grey and tan tones. The base has a slightly flared stone plinth featuring a small arched ground-level entrance with an iron-barred or wooden door. The main shaft rises with irregular courses of rectangular stone masonry and includes narrow arrow slits/windows on upper levels. The top features a slightly projecting cornice topped by four corner battlements/merlons with shallow pyramidal caps, flanking an indented flat roof platform with stone pavers. All geometry is solid, continuous, and manifold without broken polygons or floating artifacts.
blind.from_above: A square rooftop profile with four prominent square battlements at each corner, enclosing a recessed flat stone-paved roof deck.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 2.5 to 3 times as tall as the scale figure (around 15 to 17 feet tall), and about 1.5 times as wide as the figure's diameter (around 4.5 to 5 feet wide).
